description: A complete raw primary observation applies immediately without waiting for NLN.
An exact NLN witness arriving after raw correlates without a second canonical mutation.
An exact NLN-first witness mutates nothing and converges to the same result when raw arrives.
One raw mutation and one locatorless NLN witness become a singleton only at deterministic finalize.
The NLN-first singleton order has the same final correlation and zero NLN canonical authority.
An NLN-only witness expires as unmatchable and creates no canonical event.
Two raw Pump mutations carried by one transaction signature remain two canonical mutations.
A locatorless NLN witness cannot choose between two raw mutations in one signature.
A complete locator correlates one NLN witness to exactly one of multiple raw mutations.
Concrete different curve claims are a source reconciliation conflict.
Concrete different mint claims are a source reconciliation conflict.
Concrete different route variants are a source reconciliation conflict.
Concrete different trade sides are a source reconciliation conflict.
Concrete different success or error claims are a source reconciliation conflict.
Concrete different token amounts are a source reconciliation conflict.
Concrete different instruction limits are a source reconciliation conflict.
Concrete different reported curve quote claims are a source reconciliation conflict but do not change quote math.
Concrete different reported wallet settlement claims are a source reconciliation conflict.
Concrete different reported fee breakdowns are a source reconciliation conflict.
An absent optional witness claim is Unknown and is not coerced into a conflict.
Different captured payload hashes and formats do not create a semantic conflict when concrete claims agree.
A reconnect replay with the same immutable provider observation identity is a no-op despite a later receive time.
A second raw provider with the same fact is witness-only and cannot double-apply.
A second raw provider with the same locator and different concrete fact is a provider conflict without a second apply.
A raw tx_index of zero is present canonical order, not Unknown.
A primary raw observation without canonical order cannot create a structural canonical mutation.
Witness saturation is typed and incomplete but cannot consume primary authority capacity or veto later raw.
Create and initial buy in one transaction remain distinct canonical structural mutations.
A typed account-provider conflict is handed to CandidateIntegrity without becoming a strategic verdict.
One retained raw/NLN conflict inventories every lifecycle disposition without changing strategic policy semantics.
A second locatorless NLN witness prevents a false singleton match for the signature.
A primary raw observation with order but no complete source-neutral locator fails closed.
A primary raw observation without captured-payload provenance fails closed.
